description: We are a team of enthusiastic engineering students passionate about space exploration science and technology.
summary: This project explores the stories of NASA's spacecraft, rovers, landers and scientific instruments left behind on the Moon, Mars and other parts of space. It highlights important missions such as Apollo, Surveyor, Viking, Sojourner, Spirit, Opportunity and Ingenuity. Through engaging storytelling, the project explains why these machines were sent into space, how they contributed to scientific discoveries and why they eventually became inactive or remained in their locations. It also showcases their contributions to understanding planetary surfaces, ancient water and the possibility of future exploration. The main aim is to transform complex space mission histories into an interesting and accessible learning experience for students and space enthusiasts. Ultimately, this project reminds us that although these machines may have stopped working, their discoveries and contributions will never be forgotten.
details: Abandoned But Not Forgotten is an educational storytelling project about NASA's spacecraft, rovers and scientific equipment left behind on the Moon and Mars. The project uses a visually engaging PowerPoint presentation to explain the history, purpose and scientific contributions of missions such as Apollo, Surveyor, Viking, Spirit, Opportunity and Ingenuity. Its main benefit is making space exploration history interesting and understandable for students and young space enthusiasts. The intended impact is to inspire curiosity about space science and future exploration. Microsoft PowerPoint was used for designing the presentation, along with NASA's official websites and mission archives for research. Conceptual space illustrations enhance its visual appeal. The project's creativity lies in presenting forgotten space machines through storytelling rather than ordinary facts. Scientific accuracy, accessibility, simplicity and educational value were considered throughout its development.
